about: Why each PAS test in the UDAP B2B option that did not pass did not pass. Rules are matched in order against the test id (and the message when given); the first match wins. Runs before 2026-11-16 may have been affected by a stale validator terminology cache (see the README environment note); the stored results keep only each test's summary message, so this cannot be confirmed from them.

failures.cause: The UDAP kit verifies the client assertion's signature with JWT.decode when the test runs, which also checks exp then, so a five minute assertion that was valid when it arrived fails as expired.
The cancel all update did not carry certificationType 3 in Claim.extension.

Request Bundle validation. PAS 2.2.1 depends on CDex 2.1.0, which pulls in DTR 2.1.0 and CRD 2.1.0 beside CRD 2.2.1. The validator binds DTR intendedUse to CRD 2.1.0 DocReason but looks codes up under CRD 2.2.1, so no coding can pass. Clear cannot fix this.
Must support elements not sent. Some are absent on purpose because the synthetic chart has no such data (see the Clear repository's conformance notes).

notRun.reason: SMART Backend Services option. This run used UDAP B2B client credentials; the SMART option has its own section.
No authentication option. Not in scope: Clear always authenticates to a payer.

Response must support checks reported nothing to check. These did not recur in the 2026-11-16 run, which cleared the validator's terminology cache and also included Clear PRs #85 and #86. They were probably caused by the stale cache (see the environment note), Clear, or both.
No update that referenced an earlier update was checked. This did not recur in the 2026-11-16 run (cleared cache, Clear PRs #85 and #86).
Registration tests for the other authentication option, which this run did not use.
Manual attestation group. A person completes it in the Inferno interface; the run script does not.
